Thus chi_B(z)-chi_A(z)=(F-f)(S-s)(K(F)-z). The smaller eigenvalue ell_B is below its diagonal B11 and hence below r_A, so sign(r_B-r_A)=sign(r_A-K(F)) exactly; no illegal use of determinant signs alone. If R2<=R1 then K<=R2<r_A by AM-GM/Perron, giving opposite phase for all F>f. If R2>R1, K(F) falls strictly from infinity to R2 while r_A rises strictly to infinity, giving exactly one F* with the asserted order. Independently exact-rational multiplication of the submitted witness reproduces both matrices and det(I-A)=-59/800, det(I-B)=23/1600, and all diagonals below one, hence r_A>1>r_B. The paper's finite verifier uses 4000 rational profiles, but the all-parameter law follows analytically.

value.rationale: The exact retention-product inequality separates unconditional opposite-phase superiority from a unique fertility-dependent reversal in a natural positive juvenile–adult seasonal projection. It supplies a new structural classification and a biologically admissible rational witness in which only maturation phase changes the deterministic persistence side of spectral radius one. This matters for interpreting seasonal vital-rate interventions even without claiming empirical prediction or stochastic extinction.

limitations: Only strictly positive two-season two-stage linear mean model with fixed within-season retention and two maturation placements.
